name: embedding-atlas
description_en: Embedding Atlas is a tool that provides interactive visualizations for large embeddings. It allows you to visualize, cross-filter, and search embeddings and metadata.
readme_excerpt: Embedding Atlas Embedding Atlas is a tool that provides interactive visualizations for large embeddings and their metadata. You can visualize, cross-filter, and search across your data.
